ANTHROPIC $2 TRILLION IPO 34% JUMP TOPS SPACEX

Anthropic, the creator of the Claude AI model, listed on Nasdaq at $111.50 per share. The stock jumped roughly 34%, giving the company a valuation above $2 trillion, the largest IPO to date.
The massive size and price surge underline the flow of capital into the AI sector, a development closely watched by investors worldwide, including those in India.

For information only. Not investment advice.
